environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in us-east-1 VPC, fronted by an internet-facing ALB with default security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. SERVICE_MASTER_KEY is set via ECS task definition environment variable. No IP restrictions on the ALB listener. TLS termination at ALB, HTTP to container on port 8080. The /api/v1/encrypt endpoint is reachable by any internet client who can obtain or forge a valid auth token.
